Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, sustaining a
distal radius fracture consistent with the mechanism and force of the crash. Over the
course of thirteen visits, treatment proceeded along a typical recovery pathway:
immobilization, followed by progressive range-of-motion and strengthening exercises,
with visit frequency tapering as symptoms and function improved. Examination findings
include localized tenderness and reduced grip strength on the affected side that
support the fracture diagnosis, while neurovascular testing and the remaining
orthopedic maneuvers were wtihin normal limits. Review of the record shows the patient
received care for the same wrist region within the preceding two years, and that prior
condition appears to contribute to some of the current complaints. Billing records
were reviewed and reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated
entries. Continued home exercise and follow-up as needed are recommended.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
